offer.text: The spiders reached the houses while you tarried. No grudges — but make it right: bring me 16 torches to relight the watchtower.

accept.text: A lit tower is half the battle. Off you go.

decline.text: Then the tower stays dark, and so does my mood.

in_progress.text: The tower's still cold. Those torches?

ready.text: Light at last. We'll call it square.

complete.text: Everyone slips once. What matters is you came back. Now — the recruits.
